name: transcribe

subcommands.name: list-language-models

subcommands.name: list-medical-transcription-jobs

subcommands.description: Lists all tags associated with the specified transcription job, vocabulary, model, or resource.

subcommands.name: start-call-analytics-job
subcommands.description: Transcribes the audio from a customer service call and applies any additional Request Parameters you choose to include in your request.

subcommands.name: start-medical-scribe-job
subcommands.description: Transcribes patient-clinician conversations and generates clinical notes.

subcommands.name: start-medical-transcription-job
subcommands.description: Transcribes the audio from a medical dictation or conversation and applies any additional Request Parameters you choose to include in your request.

subcommands.name: start-transcription-job
subcommands.description: Transcribes the audio from a media file and applies any additional Request Parameters you choose to include in your request.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds one or more custom tags, each in the form of a key:value pair, to the specified resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes the specified tags from the specified Amazon Transcribe resource.

subcommands.name: update-call-analytics-category
subcommands.description: Updates the specified Call Analytics category with new rules.

subcommands.name: update-medical-vocabulary
subcommands.description: Updates an existing custom medical vocabulary with new values.

subcommands.name: update-vocabulary
subcommands.description: Updates an existing custom vocabulary with new values.

subcommands.name: update-vocabulary-filter
subcommands.description: Updates an existing custom vocabulary filter with a new list of words.

subcommands.name: wait
subcommands.description: Wait until a particular condition is satisfied.

subcommands.name: call-analytics-job-completed
subcommands.description: Wait until JMESPath query CallAnalyticsJob.CallAnalyticsJobStatus returns COMPLETED when polling with ``get-call-analytics-job``.

subcommands.name: language-model-completed
subcommands.description: Wait until JMESPath query LanguageModel.ModelStatus returns COMPLETED when polling with ``describe-language-model``.

subcommands.name: medical-scribe-job-completed
subcommands.description: Wait until JMESPath query MedicalScribeJob.MedicalScribeJobStatus returns COMPLETED when polling with ``get-medical-scribe-job``.

subcommands.name: medical-transcription-job-completed
subcommands.description: Wait until JMESPath query MedicalTranscriptionJob.TranscriptionJobStatus returns COMPLETED when polling with ``get-medical-transcription-job``.

subcommands.name: medical-vocabulary-ready
subcommands.description: Wait until JMESPath query VocabularyState returns READY when polling with ``get-medical-vocabulary``.

subcommands.name: transcription-job-completed
subcommands.description: Wait until JMESPath query TranscriptionJob.TranscriptionJobStatus returns COMPLETED when polling with ``get-transcription-job``.

subcommands.name: vocabulary-ready
subcommands.description: Wait until JMESPath query VocabularyState returns READY when polling with ``get-vocabulary``.
